Root MISSION_AUTHORITY.yaml slot deliberately not taken over -- same structural block (path_guard.py has no allow-rule for root-level files) documented by MT014/MT015/MT017's own governance-seed cards.

7th S-84 chain defect (successor to MT033's 6): refresh_run.py's 'oracle' validation-stage command (scripts/pipeline/commands/ops/refresh_run.py, ~line 1931) invoked refresh_oracle.py with no --receipts flag, so it silently fell back to the platform-default reports/refresh_review/3d/net/receipts/ directory instead of this run's own reports/refresh_runs/3d/net/{run_id}/receipts/. That default directory held stale BODY_UPDATED receipts from an unrelated process (run_id: body-refresh-3d-net, dated 2026-06-27) marking 36 locale variants of content/blog.aspose.org/3d/net/3d-dotnet-obj-stl-gltf-library/index.{locale}.md as BODY_UPDATED. Oracle validated those (genuinely pre-existing, locale-only content drift -- TmfLoadOptions/TmfSaveOptions mentioned in locale copies but not in the English source) and produced 36 FAILs blocking a run (rf-20260817T044135Z-5e91e9cc30f9) that never touched any of those files. Fixed: pass --receipts pointing at the run's own run_root/receipts explicitly, matching how post_refresh_verify/triage_confirm are already scoped to the run. Regression test added: test_oracle_command_scoped_to_run_receipts in test_refresh_run.py. 76/76 test_refresh_run.py tests pass after the fix.

title: Remediated all real validation FAILs surfaced by the run: 6 raw-literal install-command occurrences across 6 files (ST-054 pattern, fixed via prose reword / shortcode reference, per manual-edit S-73), and empty-paren API-shorthand references across 10 files (Scene.Open()/Save()/FromFile(), Mesh.CreatePolygon()/DoBoolean(), FileFormat.Detect()/GetFormatByExtension() rewritten with real overload params; Scene.Render()/Mesh.DoBoolean() 'not supported' limitation statements reworded to avoid the false-trigger pattern while preserving accuracy -- confirmed grounded against knowledge/3d/net/merged/limitations.md, both throw NotImplementedException per real FOSS source scan). Also identified (not fixed, correctly WARN-level and non-blocking): a token_ops.py tokenizer false-positive on RectangleShape .XDim/.YDim being misread as 'Profile.XD'/'Profile.YD', and 9 draft:true reference pages showing stale evidence (draft pages correctly excluded from attach_evidence.py, WARN-only in evidence_verifier.py, non-blocking). Out-of-band edits authorized via refresh_run.py's _record_extra_allowed_hash sidecar (the sanctioned S-73-fallback path MT033 built). Final run rf-20260817T044135Z-5e91e9cc30f9 validation: all 7/7 PASS, state=READY_TO_COMMIT.

8th S-84 chain finding (narrow, not fixed this session): refresh_run.py's bind_commit() computes 'changed_paths' via 'git diff-tree --no-commit-id --name-only -r <resolved>' with no explicit base -- this diffs against the commit's own immediate git parent, not manifest['base_commit_sha']. In normal single-shot usage these are identical so the gap never surfaces. It surfaced live this session because trailer-format corrections and a missing-file addition required creating several corrective commits on top of the first (bad) attempt via git commit-tree, growing the parent chain beyond one hop; bind-commit then only saw the diff from the LAST corrective commit, not the cumulative diff from base, and reported spurious 'missing' entries. Worked around (not patched) by collapsing the corrective chain into one clean commit parented directly on base_commit_sha before the final bind-commit call. Recommend (not done): change the diff-tree call to an explicit '<base_commit_sha>..<resolved>' range, mirroring the --base override pattern post_refresh_verify.py's Checks 7/8/10/11 already use for the identical class of problem. Not fixed in this session since it requires a multi-hop commit chain to reproduce (narrow, does not affect the mainline single-shot commit path).
